description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt to cast a Verse spell and have no Miasma remaining.

You read the patient instead of drawing on the Choir. Cast that Verse without spending Miasma, at its usual rank. Doing this does not trigger the Choir's Toll, because you did not draw past your pool — you did not draw at all. You must have Diagnosed a creature this encounter to do this, and that creature must be a target of the Verse.

cinderfall.incomplete: Miasma is this class's focus-pool-that-doesn't-refill-on-rest resource. No SpecialResource rule element exists for it anywhere in the corpus: the class card itself (classes.plaguesworn.json:49) ships system.rules: [], and grep -rl "SpecialResource" site/data/cards/feats/class/plaguesworn/ site/data/cards/classes/classes.plaguesworn.json returns zero hits. Any clause that costs, refills, or banks Miasma is unbuildable via the renew:false mechanism -- that mechanism simply isn't wired up for this class. Diagnosis is this class's own signature action (per the class card's flags.cinderfall.terms entry, classes.plaguesworn.json:82). A corpus-wide search (find site/data/cards -iname "*diagnos*") turns up only unrelated Old World Construct ancestry cards plus the three plaguesworn feats that reference it -- there is no "Diagnosis" action card anywhere in the corpus for a feat that keys off "when you Diagnose" to hook into or modify. Both the cost-waiver and the "have you Diagnosed this encounter" tracking are unbuildable.
